تعتمرن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِرْنَ (taʕtamirna) /taʕ.ta.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# تُعْتَمَرْنَ (tuʕtamarna) /tuʕ.ta.mar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
